digest.component_or_area: Infrastructure secret management and deployment configuration
propositions: MCP_HMAC_SIGNING_KEY environment variable and /rebar/prod/mcp-hmac-signing-key SSM parameter are produced (terraform slot, cloud-init transport) and injected into container environments but have zero runtime consumers in application code or services
The HMAC secret was introduced for verdict signing but that capability was superseded by asymmetric Ed25519 operation certificates per ADR 0049, with no supported rollback to the HMAC scheme
Removal is safe from a compatibility and runtime perspective (nothing breaks) but requires atomic removal across terraform producer and both transport scripts to avoid boot-time failures

Retention of this orphaned secret creates operator toil (unnecessary rotation, secret provisioning, and restore procedures) and audit noise suggesting HMAC verdict signing remains active when it does not
Safe removal requires updating six tracked infrastructure/documentation files (terraform, scripts, runbooks, operator guides) and implies one or two terraform applies with zero code or test changes
Removal is blocked pending operator approval; this assessment is read-only with no infrastructure changes executed
